annotations.title: Find a small experiment to test a career

description: Finds a small way to try, test or get a feel for a career, job, trade or field before committing to it, for someone weighing whether to quit, retrain or switch into it, e.g. 'how do I know if I'd like UX design', 'try nursing before going back to school', 'test a career change this weekend', 'is product management right for me', 'a cheap way to see if I'd enjoy teaching', 'should I quit my job to become a data analyst', 'how can I try coding before a bootcamp', 'what's it really like to be an electrician'. Works for any named career. Returns one small real-world experiment that can be finished in an evening or a weekend, what is worth noticing, and a link to carry on with OffLadder's coach.

career.description: The career, field or kind of work they're curious about, in their words.

name: find_career_experiment

continue_url.description: The same link, as the suggested next step.

cta_label.description: A short label for that link.

exact_direction.description: True when the experiment comes from one of OffLadder's written directions.

family.description: The broad family of work it sits in.

grows_from.description: Kinds of experience it can grow out of.

experiment.description: The direction with its test, a field-specific test, or null for the general method.

field.description: The field named, when OffLadder holds a field-specific test for it.

start_url.description: OffLadder's short onboarding, with a starting world picked if one was clear.

title: Find a small experiment to test a career
